meta.name: understand-knowledge
meta.description: Analyze a Karpathy-pattern LLM wiki knowledge base and generate an interactive knowledge graph with entity extraction, implicit relationships, and topic clustering.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将LLM知识库转化为交互式知识图谱
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要从大量文本中提取实体和关系并可视化
copy.tagline_en: Transform LLM knowledge base into interactive knowledge graph
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to extract entities and relationships from large text and visualize them

howto.what: 它会扫描指定目录里的 Karpathy 式 LLM wiki（原始资料、wiki markdown、schema 文件），提取实体和隐含关系，生成交互式知识图谱，并在最后自动打开看板。
howto.when: 当你想分析某个 Karpathy 式 LLM wiki 目录时触发；可用路径参数指定目录，未给则使用当前工作目录。

say.text: 分析 ./my-wiki 这个知识库，生成知识图谱

say.text: 扫描当前目录的 wiki，找出实体和隐含关系

say.text: 重新分析 docs 目录并更新 knowledge-graph.json

howto.what_en: It scans a Karpathy-pattern LLM wiki (raw sources, wiki markdown, schema file) in a directory, extracts entities and implicit relationships, builds an interactive knowledge graph, then auto-opens the dashboard.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you want to analyze a Karpathy-pattern LLM wiki directory, e.g. via /understand-knowledge with a path argument; without a path it uses the current working directory.

say_en.text: Analyze ./my-wiki and generate a knowledge graph
say_en.note: Auto-opens the dashboard at the end

say_en.text: Scan this wiki for entities and implicit relationships
say_en.note: Scan manifest first, then merged graph
